facts: W final_atk is derived from placing operator ATK plus ordinary percentage/flat ATK buffs. S2 skilldmg uses final_atk times selected skill coefficient; no token base100 damage formula is used.
limitations: Independent calculator corroborates the owner ATK basis only. It does not establish native token inheritance, birth/placement sampling, later modifier propagation or source-retirement lifetime. Its aggregate DPS, talent uptime and damage totals are not copied or treated as native execution.

transforms: RGB plus separated Alpha texture merge
atlas texture dimensions normalized and pma: true recorded

runtimeMapping.normal: CAST0, original Attack event .4, timeMode0/cap1, speed10 lifetime10/radius1 and one primary arrow; geometric splash does not multiply arrows.
runtimeMapping.s1: CAST0, literal Skill_1 event .4 with source cap1, speed8 lifetime10/radius1.2, active stun then Physical ranged NORMAL damage. waitProjectileInvalid1 keeps own noSP/attack lock through born flight or fizzle.
runtimeMapping.s2: Original SpawnToken INPUT1/capInfinite, literal Skill_2 event .267. Tile trigger min1/filterType7/alwaysRandomInTheEnd1 becomes a seeded eligible deployable/passable tile; ordinary AI uses owner as a tile-command proxy and never applies a self-damage hit. Illegal retained tile does not get a replacement.
runtimeMapping.mine: Original category2 device, zero slots/fixed direction, Start.5/realBorn1, 120s withdrawal. Hidden token skill source waitEvent0/preDelay1.5, WALK-only original radius1.35 selector, retained INPUT1 victims. Trigger once then die; native KillTokens on owner finish cleans it.
runtimeMapping.mineAtk: Current placing W ATK is sampled once and selected-rank token skill coefficient applied. Original raw token ATK100 does not establish a native owner-inheritance formula; this is a declared Global description bridge.
runtimeMapping.s3: Original CAST0/current highest HP up to selected3-4, literal Skill_3 event .5, cached selected W ATK, unmanaged static bombs. delayAfterReached1/delayTime3/keepUpdate1/stopIfDead1/stopIfDisappeared1/onlyHitWhenStop1 becomes one Stop blast at retained victim location after3s, or when original victim becomes invalid. No source withdrawal cancellation or retarget.
runtimeMapping.talent1: Native waitFirstTriggerInterval1 and selected interval10/trig_cnt1 give one deploy-anchored dodge/taunt attachment; no global phase or reset on incoming damage.
runtimeMapping.talent2: Native enemy ALL/purposeNONE range attachment and conditional STUNNED/Physical DamageScale nonstacking are mapped to strongest owned physFragile; same-frame source hit observer refreshes membership/stun before calculation.

limitations: Native C# selector, token-stat inheritance and timer/FSM dispatch are not recovered. Every numeric enum and exact original graph is retained; no native frame/playback parity is claimed.

S2 numeric TileSelector filterType7 priority is unrecovered. Seeded choice among eligible tiles retains alwaysRandomInTheEnd1 but does not claim exact native preference/distribution. Owner proxy is a narrow bridge into existing AI tile-command timing, not an allied-healing or self-damage attack.

Mine source ATK100 and generic native token stat inheritance do not establish owner sampling. This adapter explicitly samples W current ATK at placement once, then applies selected token rank damage. Native birth/talent lifetime attachment order and INPUT1 victim range revalidation are unrecovered.

S3 original StaticProjectile delay3 and separate .5 lifetime clocks do not prove the native lifetime phase/order. The chosen three-second Stop blast and early invalid-target Stop blast retain explicit fields; exact native invalid-target stop action dispatch and dynamic location update remain interpretations.

S1 active stun before same-impact damage and native full cast/noSP end ordering remain explicit interpretations. S3 own noSP/disarm lasts the original1.933 clip, independent from emitted bombs; native affecting-end versus instant SP phase is unrecovered.

Ordinary incoming Stunned uses the existing shared status classification (Freeze includes the common stun action gate); original base DB abnormal flag inheritance is unrecovered. Source talent2 literal STUNNED predicate is retained rather than claimed fully recovered.
Unity particles, bomb marks/trails and native layered/collision visuals are not reproduced. Original operator and mine skeletons/aliases are byte-identical, with no borrowed animation clips.
